sloka: सर्वं चैवाङ्गदे दोषं श्रावयिष्यामि पार्थिवे ।अमर्षी वचनं श्रुत्वा घातयिष्यति वानरान् ।। ५.६२.३२ ।।।।
transliteration: sarvaṁ caivāṅgade doṣaṁ śrāvayiṣyāmi pārthive ।amarṣī vacanaṁ śrutvā ghātayiṣyati vānarān ।। 5.62.32 ।।।।

translations.english: I will make all of Angada's faults known to the king; hearing it, the furious one will have the monkeys put to death.
